pending.title: C. elegans Synchronization by Bleaching
pending.summary: Alkaline hypochlorite dissolves gravid adult C. elegans and releases eggshell-protected embryos, which hatch in M9 without food into a synchronized, arrested L1 population. Plating these L1s onto NGM/OP50 gives a cohort of the same age for assays.

sources.citation: Stiernagle T (2006). Maintenance of C. elegans. WormBook. doi:10.1895/wormbook.1.101.1.

pending.title: Poly(A) Selection for RNA-seq
pending.summary: Oligo(dT) magnetic beads capture polyadenylated mRNA from eukaryotic total RNA (mammalian cells as the example) so that rRNA is removed before RNA-seq library prep. This generic workflow uses two binding rounds for high purity; kit-specific values are labeled.

sources.citation: New England Biolabs. Isolate mRNA using the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (E7490), protocol (undated web version).

pending.title: Enzyme Kinetics Michaelis-Menten Assay
pending.summary: Measure initial reaction rates of E. coli β-galactosidase with ONPG in a 96-well plate reader, convert absorbance with a product standard curve, and fit Km and Vmax by nonlinear regression with linearized-plot cross-checks.

pending.summary: Quantify a small antigen in cell culture supernatant by indirect competitive ELISA: coat antigen, pre-incubate sample with limiting primary antibody, detect with HRP and TMB, and fit an inverse four-parameter curve.

pending.summary: Isolate plasmid DNA from 2 mL of E. coli overnight culture with homemade P1, P2 and P3 buffers, isopropanol precipitation and an ethanol wash, then check yield, purity and identity.

pending.title: BCA Protein Assay
pending.summary: Measure total protein in lysates with the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay in a 96-well plate: prepare BSA standards (25–2,000 µg/mL), mix the working reagent, incubate, read at 562 nm and calculate concentrations from the standard curve.
